title: Coiled Basket Making
note: A low-capital craft business that turns locally sourced grasses, sisal, and cord into high-value decorative and functional baskets for tourists and export buyers.

startup.item: Assorted awls, tapestry needles, and scissors set
Sisal twine and core rope (10 kg)
Work mat, storage bins, and labeling supplies
Phone tripod and photo backdrop for product shots
Business registration and craft fair entry fees

monthlyFixed.item: Airtime and mobile data for marketing
Transport to markets and material sourcing
